translation.name: Diosa' kiika; Génesis, Éxodo y El Nuevo Testamento

content: Tsa' mitya ñulla Cristoba bulu mangujtaiñu deimiya, selusha Diosa' chunu urandyasha chumu Cristonaa tengaya judei.
Tsaju' kai'sha chumu tyee kesa tyañuba juntsaaya kiiken chunu aa pensa deju', entsa tusha tyee kataamuñuba juntsaaya kenu aa pensanguen chutyudei,
matyu ñullaya juntsaa kiikenuya peyaañuuya deju', Cristoba bulu chunu, Dioschi vela' kayaaya deju' mitya.
Tsaju' Cristoren ñullanu uwain chuwaanu tiremu juuve, tsejtu ya naa-uwanu mangatawañuba ñui bain yaba buluren ya tsamantsaa juñu juntsaba mangatawanu dejuve.
Challaya kaspeetsaa chumu dejutyuyu.

Tiba ujcha kiikenu juulaya ñulla jaiba tsanguityui tiyadei: mu bain na'baasa tsa tsa-in dechutyusa, naa Dioschi firu' kurainuu bain dekityusa, naa na'baasa firu' pensa juu bain dekityusa, tsenmin kayu lushi tadichi tya' esmu dejutyusa, matyu juntsaa jutu chi dyusnu aawa kure' keewaakeñuuve.
Tsaju' kumuinchi juntsaa kiikeñu jumula' mityaa, Dios ajaatya' taaju de-iware' puitemu juve meenguityulanuya,
naa ñui bain kaspeleya juntsaaya ken chumuwa deeve.
Tsaaren challaya kumuinchi entsaa jumula mantyu tiyadei: naa ajara pensa bain, naa firu' mannu pensa bain, naa kentsure' firu' panu palaa bain, tsenmin mayujpeyaa pai'nuu palaa jumula bain.
Tsenmin ñuitala veta' veta' anbutin chutyudei, ñullaya kaspele naaken chumuwa deju'ba challaya tsa manguen chutyu chachi detiya' jintsu',
kasa chachi juu detiyamiya, ñullanu ke' kujtemu Dios naajuñuba juntsaaya tiya' jijiintsumiya, ya naajuñuba kayu narai keemijandetsuve.

Tsaju' challaya naa griego chachi juñu bain, naa judío chachi juñu bain, naa Dioschi señas juñu bain, naa señas jutyuñu bain, naa vee tusha chumu juñu bain, naa vee palaachi pamu chachi kerandyatyuu kuramu juñu bain, naa manda-i' taawasha kemu juñu bain, naa nejuu maali chumu chachi juñu bain, juntsaya tiba jutyuve, matyu Cristaa tinuba depullaa ju', naajulaba yanu keenguemulanuya chuñu' mitya.

Dios ñullanu estyamu ju' mi'ke' ka', yachin juu chachi jumulaba buunanu tiwaañu' mitya, yuj tenbipu chachi juu bain, aa ura chachi juu bain, daj pensajtu chachi juu bain, naa veela ti meneste deeñuba tsa tsanguemishtimu bain, tsenmin jei tiba kidandai paijtyu chachi juu bain tiyadei.

Naa firu' dekiñuba tsanguive tyatyuuñuu ju' veta' veta' ura' chudei, tsejtu main mulaanu kuipa pukenuu ju' bain juntsa' mitya kuipa faawaan jutyu tiya tiyaidei, tsaju' Bale Ruku naake' ñulla' ujcha manbitsale' tiba jutyu tireñuba ñui bain veelanu tsanguen chudei.
Tsejtu kayu veta' veta' mika estyan chunuuya tiyadei, tsanguen dechushu juntsaa kumuinchi ma bulu juu tirekaamu juñu' mitya.

Tsenmala Cristochi tiba bulla jutyu chukaanu pensa bain ñulla' tenbukasha chusa urake pensanguikaanutsu, matyu Diosya ñullanu tiba bulla jutyu ma bulu juu chukaanaa tsangue' mikañu' mitya. Tsejtu Diosnu yuj urave tin chudei.

Naa-uwanuba ñulla' pensasha Cristo' kuinda naaju tsamantsa uukera ju'ba tsanasa, tsejtu veta' veta' mijakaren dechu', uumi'ten chudei naajuñuba aseetaju' kiikendu. Tsenmin ñulla' tenbuka yuj ura' kive tya' mika sunden pensa juuya Diosnu salmu beesa juu bain, naa Diosnu kenu beesa juula bain, naa Espíritu Santo tsandikaañu beesa juula bain kiikidei.
Tsenmin ti kike' bain, ti pati' bain uwain Bale Ruku Jesús' chachilla ju' tsa tsanguidei, ya' mityaa Apa Diosnu yuj ura' kive tiitindu.
Keranguemu chachiyanaaken chunuu juñuba
Supulaya ya' rukulanu meenguen chudei, matyu Bale Rukunu keenguemuya juntsaaya junuuñu' mitya.
Tsenmala unbee rukulaya ñulla' shinbulanu estyadei; na'baasa firu' kiiken chutyudei.
Nalaya, ñulla' apala tyee depañuba tinu bain meenguidei, tsa deenmalaya Bale Ruku uutyamu juñu' mitya.
Tsenmala apalaya, ñulla' nalanu firu' uudenguemu jutyudei, sunden jutyuu tiyai'nudetsu.

Manda-i' taawasha kemu chachillaya, ñullanu entsa tusha uudenguen chumu chachilla naadetiñuba meenguidei, tsejtu ne yala dekeenañaa meengue' yaichi ura' katawanu tya' kityumujchi, uwain ñulla' pensachiren tsangue meenguenuu juve tenñaa tsanguidei, Bale Rukunu balengure' jeetya' keewaatu.
Tsejtu ti kike' bain mika ajchundya' sunden kiideke', Bale Rukuchee tsangue taawasha kendetsuyu tya', chachillachee tsanguendetsuyu tyatyudei.
Matyu ñullaya mideeve tsanguen chun mitya bene Bale Rukuren yachi tiba jumula kuwanu pañu bain juntsaa kanu deju'ba, ñullaya Bale Ruku Cristochee taawasha kendetsu' mitya.
Tsaaren mun naa naake firu' ken chumu ju' bain, juntsan mitya tsa tsai taaju i' puinu juve, matyu Diosya mainnuren ura' kiikemu ju', kamainnuya firu' kiikemu jutyuñu' mitya.
